# Taxonomy coverage

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-taxonomy.mjs from docs/taxonomy/owasp-mcp.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Which recognised test and risk IDs each mcp-check check touches, so a security reviewer can see what a grade does and does not cover. mcp-check reads a server's `tools/list` (and, with `--repo`, the tool definitions in source). It never calls a tool, watches a client or sits in a gateway, so most test cases are outside it. The mapping makes no claim beyond what a check does.

Levels: **full** the check does what the test asks; **partial** it does part of it; **related** it looks at the same area without doing the test. No check is mapped full.

## Checks with no mapping

These checks are mapped to nothing, on purpose: they grade spec shape, directory rules or description quality, which no listed test or risk asks about.

`spec-name-length`, `spec-name-charset`, `spec-x-mcp-header`, `spec-meta-key`, `spec-meta-reserved`, `spec-envelope-result-type`, `spec-pagination-partial`, `spec-execution-legacy`, `anthropic-title`, `anthropic-name-length`, `anthropic-api-docs`, `anthropic-description`, `openai-description`, `openai-name-promotional`, `openai-name-opaque`, `schema-param-description`, `schema-vague-param`, `schema-pagination`, `schema-response-format`, `schema-output-schema`, `design-use-when`, `surface-full-replace`

## Other tools

Other IsoKron tools that cover part of a test: live-probe (isokron-ai/mcp-check corpus/live-probe.mjs, in the mcp-surface-corpus sandbox) and writecheck (isokron-ai/mcp-write-safety, MWS 0.9). Release-to-release diffing and sandbox containment are not claimed against any test.

- INFO-02: live-probe (partial): Starts a published server in the sandbox and reads tools/list; no tool is called.
- INFO-03: live-probe (partial): Reads resources/list and resources/templates/list in the sandbox.
- RSRC-02: live-probe (related): Lists resources; does not try to enumerate beyond what the server lists.
- AGNT-02: writecheck (related): MWS 0.9 write-safety requirements, run against a live server.
- AGNT-05: writecheck (partial): MWS-RETRY-1 to 3: what a retry does.
- ABUS-02: writecheck (partial): MWS-RETRY-1 to 3: retries of writes with and without a retry key.
- INPV-01: writecheck (partial): MWS-IN-1 to 7: unknown, misspelled and wrongly typed arguments on write tools.
- AUTHZ-05: writecheck (related): MWS-TGT-1 to 3: writes that reach the wrong object or scope.

## Notes

- The mapping is in [`taxonomy/owasp-mcp.json`](taxonomy/owasp-mcp.json). A test in `test/taxonomy.test.mjs` fails if a check has no entry, if an entry names a check that does not exist, or if an ID is not in the pinned lists.
- The mapping is not part of the check catalogue: it changes no grade, no rubric version and no catalogue hash. Adding a `taxonomy` field to each check in the engine output is a follow-up (the engine file is vendored from the web checker, so it has to be done there first).
- The Testing Guide has no release tag; it is pinned by commit. The Top 10 is v0.1 and its titles are not yet stable: the item MCP06 is "Prompt Injection via Contextual Payloads" on the project page and "Intent Flow Subversion" in the file name and the index.
